reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and wraps it in one getDateWithWeekendRule that getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and the budget template all call.

duplication.why: The skip/move/daily/holiday decision exists once; the remaining repetition is look-ahead window arithmetic (DAILY_SCAN_WINDOW + holidays) in two places and a separate WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS constant.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts alongside the existing date helpers; server code only iterates occurrences and applies it.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the weekend/holiday rule, the new handler, the data passthrough and tests.

maintainability.why: One definition with null meaning 'skipped' is easy to own; the WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS padding in getDatesInRange does not account for holidays, so the window constants are a small place where the rule and its consumers can drift.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; the daily case is a single branch inside the new getDateWithWeekendRule, which every consumer calls
